display_title: [Pure Romance Anthology] When the Top Student of the Magic Department and the Top Student of the Swordsmanship Department Get Trapped in an XX Room
description:
“Why? Do you want to kiss me?” Sol nodded, unable to take her eyes off his deep pupils, which seemed to draw people in. For some reason, she became endlessly honest in front of him. Maybe it was because she felt that, until she made all three wishes, he would be completely on her side. A faint dimple appeared on Jinhwi’s cheek as he stretched his lips into a straight line. Was it just her imagination that he looked nervous…? “As long as we don’t go all the way, kissing is fine.” He whispered in a gentle voice as he brushed Sol’s hair aside with his hand. Did saying kissing was fine mean that if they went all the way, it would count as the third wish? “Then what exactly counts as ‘going all the way’?”
